positions.as_written: Use a cartilage sensitive sequence, since a routine protocol understates the loss.
Assess the depth against the full thickness of the adjacent cartilage.
Assess the area in two planes, because a defect's extent is easily underestimated from one.
Assess the surrounding cartilage, which decides whether the lesion is focal.
Assess the subchondral plate and marrow, which distinguishes a chondral from an osteochondral lesion.
- The subchondral plate must be assessed.
